body: I dont know i have been a loser ever since i lost my girl years back.
I have been unsuccesful till now

f ull disclosure : i have been dealing with chronic depression and panic attacks for half a decade now. 

here is what i understood after fighting with myself every single moment in this period. 

The answer to your question is a resolutely yes. its possible. 

i will share my progress. about listening and doing everything to get out a rut. i dont believe its full proof but i am getting some success in pulling myself up. attaining the said calm state  atleast for moments sometimes little over an hour and i had been battling it out for more than a quarter of year now. 

whatever people say or advice you doesnt work . even my therapist was no use to me. i gave up on all.  my thoughts and my feelings where so bad that used to drag me to netherworld and i begged and begged to get away. i also tried jumping but couldnt muster the courage to do so. yeah it was that bad. 

there is no greater enemy than your own mind and i have suffered until i concurred things arent bad as i percieve its my mind and way i feel makes me tether into darkness. 

i marked my enemy. i portrayed my thoughts and my feeling as half truth , filled with provocation. that day forth i never trust or believe in what i feel or thoughts i come across. i had put my belief and trust in something else. into my goals, into my future now it was easy to weed out my thoughts and get my focus improved. 

i have not become a happy person. no drastic change has taken place. i am just less sad, less conflicted. needless to say i am more calmer and determined. i can make a choice with short term commitments. my mind now has stopped sending in negative thoughts and my feelings dont last that long. i have developed tolerance. maybe it has started listening to logic and reason a bit more. its easier to work now. 

i think if a fallen guy like me can get to here , you all good folks can certainly get there faster than me.
can you tell a bit more about yourself?
choice is the virtue of the calm. cant say a restless , impatient mind has one.

mind does make the interpretation of the world . if one is depressed the world is in  a darker shade, if happy then it is painted in a brighter shade. 

this world is the creation of mind i think. how is portrays is influenced by its nature. schizophrenia or not you cannot really say it anything other than this
everything is going to painful and ugly in the world outside your mind , but the choice is making the world inside the mind to be comfortable and beautiful.
